title: Small data-plane API change needs review

question: I have a spec PR with a small additive change to my data-plane API. How do I request Board review and get signoff without booking a meeting?
ground_truth: For a minor change that qualifies for offline review, email azureapirbcore@microsoft.com at least two days before you need signoff. Include your spec PR, accessible design documents and hero scenarios, the prior review if applicable, and a summary of your changes. Not every additive change qualifies; the Board can arrange a synchronous session for larger changes. data-plane-review-requested queues the review, while an authorized API Stewardship reviewer applies the protected data-plane-review-signoff label after completing the review.
source: Anonymized export thread 1774850126722 (2026-03-30); stewardship-knowledge-materials.md D01, current-process summary
